answer_4.quote: we conduct a human evaluation of EdiText and several baseline models on the task of modifying Enron data to a negative sentiment using Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant was shown sentiment-edited outputs from EdiText and three baselines that achieved comparable levels of attribute shifting toward the negative target. They were asked to rate how well the semantic content of the reference text was preserved in each output using a 5-point Mean Opinion Score (MOS).
